# Experiment uncovers a Triceratops


Hey backers, you raised $6,775 for a dinosaur dig led by Jason Schein and the[Bighorn Basin Dinosaur Project](https://www.facebook.com/pages/Bighorn-Basin-Dinosaur-Project/326961870839356) .


We drove out to Wyoming to spend some time in the field with Jason and his team. We found a Triceratops!


Check out the story on Exposure!


[https://experiment.exposure.co/uncovering-a-triceratops](https://experiment.exposure.co/uncovering-a-triceratops)
